Title: GitHub Actions Coverage and Docs Artifacts
Content: MemorySmith has two GitHub Actions workflows for CI and published documentation artifacts. .github/workflows/ci.yml restores, builds, and tests the solution on ubuntu-latest with .NET 10, collects XPlat Code Coverage in Cobertura format through coverlet.collector, generates an HTML/Cobertura/Markdown coverage report with dotnet-reportgenerator-globaltool, appends the Markdown summary to the GitHub step summary, and uploads cobertura-coverage plus coverage-html-report artifacts. The equivalent local coverage command was validated on 2026-05-17 and produced artifacts/TestResults/**/coverage.cobertura.xml with 146 passing tests. .github/workflows/docs-pages.yml mirrors the TMXLang-style Doxygen Pages workflow: install doxygen and graphviz, run doxygen docs/Doxyfile, upload doxygen-wiki-html, upload the Pages artifact from docs/output/html, and deploy GitHub Pages. docs/Doxyfile uses README.md as the main page and includes MemorySmith.Core/Docs, MemorySmith.App, MemorySmith.Core, MemorySmith.Storage, and Schemas with source browsing, tree view, and Graphviz diagrams enabled. Local Doxygen generation requires doxygen and graphviz on PATH; the GitHub workflow installs them before generation.
